Show keystrokes on a website

~

When recording screen casts or doing live demos, I typically rely on a native application to visualize keystrokes on screen. That dependency is one more thing a corporate policy can take away.

So I built a web-native solution to fill that gap, and the code to embed it is one script tag and one custom element on the page.

<script type="module" src="https://example.com/element.js"></script>

Try the https://example.com/demo route, or read the documentation for details.
